name: Lightbox
usage: Previewing images, enlarging an image while picking images

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when switching to another image.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when closing (`Esc`, the close button, clicking outside the image, dragging it away).

props.name: stage
props.description:
Fixed background step; when omitted, the viewer background from ThemeProvider is used and can be changed in
the toolbar.

fields.name: id
fields.description:
Unique ID; when the current image changes, the image element is replaced, so the previous image is not shown
while the next one loads.

fields.name: alt
fields.description: Alternative text, read by screen readers and shown by the browser when the image fails to load.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Opened and switched as a controlled component; the viewer background is a neutral gray by default and does not
change with the theme.
